Role Overview

We are seeking two Senior Design Verification Engineers to architect and execute comprehensive verification strategies for our next-generation high-performance SoCs. In this role, you will take technical ownership of IP-level and subsystem-level verification for mission-critical high-speed serial protocols, specifically PCIe and USB.
Beyond standard UVM and constrained-random methodologies, you will be a catalyst for modernizing our verification flow—integrating AI/LLM-assisted workflows to accelerate test writing, assertion generation, log triage, and coverage closure.

Key Responsibilities
1.Testbench Architecture & Test Planning

a. Define, author, and review detailed Verification Plans (vPlans) from architectural and micro-architectural specifications through tape-out sign-off.
b. Architect, build, and maintain modular, scalable, and reusable UVM-based testbenches from scratch, including custom drivers, monitors, scoreboards, predictors, and reference models.
c. Drive constrained-random test generation, SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA), and functional coverage metrics to achieve 100％ coverage sign-off.

2.High-Speed Subsystem & Protocol Verification

a. Lead IP- and subsystem-level verification for PCIe (Gen 4/5/6) and USB (USB 3.2 / USB4 / Type-C) controllers and PHY interfaces (PIPE/UTMI).
b. Verify complex protocol dynamics, including:

i. Link Training and Status State Machine (LTSSM) transitions and recovery loops.
ii. Low-power states (ASPM L0s, L1, L1.

jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
As a Manufacturing Lab Systems Engineer, you will support critical test environments at Apple's Taiwan manufacturing facility for our new product introduction (NPI) development process. You will own the cross-functional lab environment that serves as the on-ramp for silicon validation, software, hardware test, and reliability teams to access newly produced systems weeks ahead of deployment to our U.S.-based hardware labs. Working closely with in-region EE teams, you will debug, triage, and manage newly manufactured hardware deployed in these labs, while coordinating with U.S.-based Lab Engineering and Systems EE teams to support remote lab access. This role demands equal parts technical depth and operational ownership - grounded in systems engineering with electrical, software, and integration experience - with teams counting on you across every time zone. Come join us!
  
  
Description
  
  
Leveraging your expertise in server platforms and electrical engineering, you will work closely with the in-region System Electrical Engineering team on debugging and triaging hardware issues, serving as the on-site directly responsible individual (DRI) for the labs at this facility. You will be the execution arm for NPI programs, coordinating with our CM partner to move assets from the manufacturing line into lab environments under the direction of the System EPM. This requires hands-on ability to lead root cause analysis, rework, and change management with in-region teams. You will coordinate and track the movement of factory servers from the manufacturing line to all lab environments, partnering with U.S.-based System EPMs and in-region team members spanning software, reliability, diagnostics, test, and EE. jobs.description:
**Job Description & Summary**

「人才與組織變革諮詢服務」(People & Organization Consulting Service)，隸屬於資誠聯合會計師事務所聯盟事業，我們團隊專注於協助企業客戶進行人才管理與組織轉型，以達到企業永續發展。
  
我們正在招募具發展潛力的實習生加入團隊。你將參與數據驅動的人力資源專案，實際投入市場薪酬數據分析、生成式 AI 應用與 Python 工具實作，並接觸人資顧問專案執行，累積數據分析與數位工具應用的實務經驗。
  
  
\*\*投遞履歷時請附上數據分析或簡報製作相關的專案或作品集，協助我們更具體的了解您的能力，謝謝。
  
  

* 預計報到日：2026年11 月 (可討論)
* 預計工作時間：實習期間至少六個月，每週能配合至少2.5天
* 工作地點：資誠台北所(台北市信義區基隆路一段333號-國貿大樓)
* 附勞健保及團保，以時薪計薪

工作任務：
  
作為顧問團隊的一員，您的任務包含但不限於：
  
  
數據分析與視覺化（60%）
  

* 參與市場薪酬數據分析專案[MC1.1]，實際投入從公開資料蒐集、清理與品質檢核、數據分析與視覺化，到市場洞察報告撰寫的完整流程，並依專案需求運用 Python、Excel、Power BI、PowerPoint 等工具。
* 分析組織營運、員工問卷等專案數據，將分析發現轉化為視覺化圖表與初步洞察，並參與 Power BI 儀表板的維護與優化

  
生成式 AI 與 Python 工具應用（30%）
  

* 依團隊需求建立、測試與優化生成式 AI Agent，並進行生成式 AI 指令設計（Prompt Design），支持議題研究、知識運用及專案執行。
* 開發及優化 Python 工具，應用於資料處理、數據分析及重複性作業等情境，提升團隊工作效率。

  
專案支援與議題研究（10%）
  

* 支援顧問簡報的製作與視覺優化
* 參與顧問方法論開發、趨勢調研等前瞻性議題研究
* 依專案需求，支援專案訪談、工作坊執行或擔任課程助教
* 協助會議、活動籌備等團隊日常營運事務

你將獲得：
  

* 數據分析實戰經驗：參與從資料蒐集、清理與品質檢核、分析與視覺化，到洞察報告撰寫的完整歷程，理解如何將原始資料轉化為具商業價值的分析成果。
* 生成式AI 與工具實作機會：參與團隊內部生成式 AI Agent、指令設計及 Python 工具的建立與優化，累積運用新興技術改善工作流程的經驗。
* 人資顧問專案實務：接觸薪酬、人才發展及員工意見調查等專案，學習以顧問思維拆解問題並提煉數據洞察。
* 專業的指導與多元的學習資源：由專屬顧問教練（Coach）提供一對一指導，並透過與不同領域的資深顧問及部門最高主管互動，學習顧問方法、產業洞察與商業思維。組內開放的氛圍歡迎你隨時提問；你也能運用事務所豐富的學習資源，加速個人成長。
* 表現優秀者有優先轉正機會

  
  

必要條件：
  

* 學士三年級以上或碩/博士在學學生
* 能於2026年10月至11月間到職，且實習期間至少六個月，每週能配合至少2.5天
* 具基本資料分析與視覺化能力（Excel樞紐分析與函數、PowerPoint 圖表製作或其他類似工具）
* 具備統計知識與數據思維，重視資料與產出品質
* 具備 Python 基礎，曾修習相關課程或完成基礎專案
* 主動積極且樂於學習，具問題分析與解決、溝通表達、及團隊合作能力

  
加分條件：
  

* 具備Python 實作經驗，能運用 Pandas, NumPy 等套件進行資料清理與分析
* 具備生成式 AI 應用或 Vibe Coding 經驗，曾建立 AI Agent 或自動化工具者尤佳
* 曾使用 Power BI 等 BI 工具建立儀表板
* 對人力資源、組織發展或管理顧問領域抱有高度興趣
* 具備良好的中、英文溝通能力，TOEIC 800 分以上或相當程度者尤佳
